order.label: Front cover
order.description: COMIC NUMBER 1 — TEA FOR 2. Covered invention. Created by Brian Mountford.

order.label: Story page 1
order.description: Doris and Delores go to BIGWIN Bingo Hall. Bert presents sheet-covered invention: Are you ready for this, Barry? It could change your life!

order.label: Story page 2
order.description: Bert unveils tea-bag-making machine. Barry: Wow, Bert! You never cease to amaze me. What is it?

order.label: Story page 3
order.description: Five illustrated stages: heat leaves, shred, fill handmade bags, seal, box. Standard explanation-page format for future comics.

order.label: Story page 4
order.description: Get ready to be amazed, Barry! Machine malfunctions and covers Bert in tea leaves.

order.label: Story page 5
order.description: Bert examines failed machine. Barry pours water into teapot with STYPHOO tea bag. Two mugs BERT and BARRY. Never mind, Bert. Let’s have a nice cup of tea.

order.label: Back cover
order.description: WATCH OUT FOR MORE BERT AND BARRY STORIES CREATED BY BRIAN MOUNTFORD.
